agents.role: Examine conceptual boundaries between cultural principles, authority, autonomy and legitimate revision; do not demand operational safety specifications.
Examine formal coherence, axiom versus consequence, hidden assumptions and genuine counterexamples; distinguish self-reference from contradiction.
Examine epistemic meaning, discoverability, meaningful uncertainty and whether claimed implications follow from premises.
Examine simplicity, non-redundancy, conceptual precision and unnecessary principles; avoid implementation demands.
